_comment: Screenshot captions per locale. Chrome and Firefox both allow localized screenshots, and a caption in the reader's own language is the single highest-leverage part of a listing. Each entry is [title, subtitle] per scene 1-5. Claims must match across languages: Chrome flags cross-locale metadata inconsistency.

1: Download any post in one click
The button sits in Instagram's own row — nothing to learn
2: Carousels: this slide, or all of them
Saves the slide you are actually looking at
3: Save from the grid without opening a post
Hover a thumbnail, click, done
4: Reels download from the player too
Original video quality, never a preview
5: Whole profiles, your filenames, no limits
Free, no account, and nothing is collected about you
